name: @folio/worker
description: The whole app on Cloudflare: the web build and API on Pages, market data precomputed by a cron Worker.

scripts.build: wrangler pages functions build --compatibility-date 2026-09-30 --compatibility-flags nodejs_compat --outdir dist/functions && wrangler deploy -c cron/wrangler.jsonc --dry-run --outdir dist/cron
scripts.deploy: npm run build -w @folio/web && wrangler pages deploy --branch main --commit-dirty=true && wrangler deploy -c cron/wrangler.jsonc
